snippet.title: Haunted House Hellshift  - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the trailer that is on the Steam Page at https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094290/Haunted_House_Hellshift/

The Demo is now LIVE! I'd love to hear your thoughts on the game!

Inspired by classic arcade action like Gauntlet and Smash TV, Haunted House Hellshift mixes campy haunted house horror, local co-op monster combat, game show energy, and over-the-top mayhem.

WISHLIST ON STEAM : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094290/Haunted_House_Hellshift/

⚠️ Work-in-progress build
Some visuals, balance, effects, UI, and mechanics are still being improved before release.

Feedback is welcome. There is a feedback form on the game page. Steam page coming soon.

#HauntedHouseHellshift #IndieGame #HorrorGame #TopDownShooter #LocalCoop #SteamDemo #WishlistOnSteam #ArcadeShooter
